main_measure.name: mean 72-bar forward return, grind group minus jump group
main_measure.threshold: confirm: difference > 0 with Welch t >= 2; reject: difference < 0 with Welch t <= -2; at least 200 grid cases per group

decided_by: The Welch t is between -2 and 2 (or its sign disagrees with the difference), which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: The sample is the grid bars (positions 0, 72, 144, ... of each window) with raw grind_residual above 0 and a 72-bar forward return inside the window; the per-coin median is taken over that coin's sample across all its windows; the plan's 200-case minimum, when not met, is reported as not observable.
